tooltips.paymentTerms:
100% upfront / Full payment in advance: Pay in full before work/shipment begins.
Deposit + balance: Deposit + remaining balance. E.g., 30% deposit, 70% upon completion.
Milestone payment: Payment based on project milestones.
COD (Cash on Delivery): Payment upon physical delivery.
Net 7 / Net 30 / Net 60: Payment due within 7/30/60 days after receiving the invoice.
50/50: 50% upfront, 50% upon completion/delivery.
Progressive payment: Phased payments as work progresses.
Payment upon delivery: Payment due when delivery is made.
Payment upon acceptance: Payment due after customer inspection and acceptance.
Retainer: Advance payment of a fixed amount for ongoing services/development, deducted from the balance later.
Recurring billing: Automatic billing on a monthly/quarterly/annual basis, e.g., SaaS.
Letter of Credit (L/C): A letter of credit, common in international trade.
Escrow: Third-party custody, funds released after both parties meet agreed conditions.
Pay-when-paid: Payment to subcontractors is made only after receiving payment from the client, common in construction.
